courier-relay/protocol-selection: Courier Relay protocol selection: an omitted "protocol" key selects the current protocol version (constant CURRENT_PROTOCOL in main.py, "1" as of 2026-09-07). An explicit supported version selects that version. A known command with an explicit unsupported/unknown protocol version returns {"error":"unknown_protocol"}; unknown commands still return {"error":"unknown_command"} regardless of protocol. Protocol handlers are dispatched via PROTOCOLS in main.py: command -> version -> handler. Decided while implementing trial-gbn (count, protocol 1); future protocol-version issues should keep both error shapes stable.
